from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence


def transform(text: str, upper: bool = False, reverse: bool = False) -> str:
    if upper:
        text = text.upper()
    if reverse:
        text = text[::-1]
    return text


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Transform text with optional flags.')
    parser.add_argument('--upper', action='store_true', help='uppercase the text')
    parser.add_argument('--reverse', action='store_true', help='reverse the text')
    parser.add_argument('text', nargs='*', metavar='TEXT', help='text to transform')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    if not args.text:
        parser.error('the following arguments are required: TEXT')

    print(transform(' '.join(args.text), upper=args.upper, reverse=args.reverse))
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
